66732:1.title: Chapter One: The Vanishing of Will Byers
66732:1.overview: On his way home from a friend's house, young Will sees something terrifying. Nearby, a sinister secret lurks in the depths of a government lab.

66732:1.title: Chapter Two: The Weirdo on Maple Street
66732:1.overview: Lucas, Mike and Dustin try to talk to the girl they found in the woods. Hopper questions an anxious Joyce about an unsettling phone call.

66732:1.title: Chapter Three: Holly, Jolly
66732:1.overview: An increasingly concerned Nancy looks for Barb and finds out what Jonathan's been up to. Joyce is convinced Will is trying to talk to her.

66732:1.title: Chapter Four: The Body
66732:1.overview: Refusing to believe Will is dead, Joyce tries to connect with her son. The boys give Eleven a makeover. Nancy and Jonathan form an unlikely alliance.

66732:1.title: Chapter Five: The Flea and the Acrobat
66732:1.overview: Hopper breaks into the lab while Nancy and Jonathan confront the force that took Will. The boys ask Mr. Clarke how to travel to another dimension.

66732:1.title: Chapter Six: The Monster
66732:1.overview: A frantic Jonathan looks for Nancy in the darkness, but Steve's looking for her, too. Hopper and Joyce uncover the truth about the lab's experiments.

66732:1.title: Chapter Seven: The Bathtub
66732:1.overview: Eleven struggles to reach Will, while Lucas warns that "the bad men are coming." Nancy and Jonathan show the police what Jonathan caught on camera.

66732:1.title: Chapter Eight: The Upside Down
66732:1.overview: Dr. Brenner holds Hopper and Joyce for questioning while the boys wait with Eleven in the gym. Back at Will's, Nancy and Jonathan prepare for battle.

66732:2.title: Chapter One: MADMAX
66732:2.overview: As the town preps for Halloween, a high-scoring rival shakes things up at the arcade, and a skeptical Hopper inspects a field of rotting pumpkins.

66732:2.title: Chapter Two: Trick or Treat, Freak
66732:2.overview: After Will sees something terrible on trick-or-treat night, Mike wonders whether Eleven's still out there. Nancy wrestles with the truth about Barb.

66732:2.title: Chapter Three: The Pollywog
66732:2.overview: Dustin adopts a strange new pet, and Eleven grows increasingly impatient. A well-meaning Bob urges Will to stand up to his fears.

66732:2.title: Chapter Four: Will the Wise
66732:2.overview: An ailing Will opens up to Joyce -- with disturbing results. While Hopper digs for the truth, Eleven unearths a surprising discovery.

66732:2.title: Chapter Five: Dig Dug
66732:2.overview: Nancy and Jonathan swap conspiracy theories with a new ally as Eleven searches for someone from her past. “Bob the Brain” tackles a difficult problem.

66732:2.title: Chapter Six: The Spy
66732:2.overview: Will's connection to a shadowy evil grows stronger, but no one's quite sure how to stop it. Elsewhere, Dustin and Steve forge an unlikely bond.

66732:2.title: Chapter Seven: The Lost Sister
66732:2.overview: Psychic visions draw Eleven to a band of violent outcasts and an angry girl with a shadowy past.

66732:2.title: Chapter Eight: The Mind Flayer
66732:2.overview: An unlikely hero steps forward when a deadly development puts the Hawkins Lab on lockdown, trapping Will and several others inside.

66732:2.title: Chapter Nine: The Gate
66732:2.overview: Eleven makes plans to finish what she started while the survivors turn up the heat on the monstrous force that's holding Will hostage.

1396:1.title: Pilot
1396:1.overview: When an unassuming high school chemistry teacher discovers he has a rare form of lung cancer, he decides to team up with a former student and create a top of the line crystal meth in a used RV, to provide for his family once he is gone.

1396:1.title: Cat's in the Bag...
1396:1.overview: Walt and Jesse attempt to tie up loose ends. The desperate situation gets more complicated with the flip of a coin. Walt's wife, Skyler, becomes suspicious of Walt's strange behavior.

1396:1.title: ...And the Bag's in the River
1396:1.overview: Walter fights with Jesse over his drug use, causing him to leave Walter alone with their captive, Krazy-8. Meanwhile, Hank has a scared straight moment with Walter Jr. after his aunt discovers he has been smoking pot. Also, Skylar is upset when Walter stays away from home.

1396:1.title: Cancer Man
1396:1.overview: Walter finally tells his family that he has been stricken with cancer. Meanwhile, the DEA believes Albuquerque has a new, big time player to worry about. Meanwhile, a worthy recipient is the target of a depressed Walter's anger, and Jesse makes a surprise visit to his parents home.

1396:1.title: Gray Matter
1396:1.overview: Walter and Skyler attend a former colleague's party. Jesse tries to free himself from the drugs, while Skyler organizes an intervention.

1396:1.title: Crazy Handful of Nothin'
1396:1.overview: The side effects of chemo begin to plague Walt. Meanwhile, the DEA rounds up suspected dealers.

1396:1.title: A No Rough Stuff Type Deal
1396:1.overview: Walter accepts his new identity as a drug dealer after a PTA meeting. Elsewhere, Jesse decides to put his aunt's house on the market and Skyler is the recipient of a baby shower.

1396:2.title: Seven Thirty-Seven
1396:2.overview: Walt and Jesse are vividly reminded of Tuco’s volatile nature, and try to figure a way out of their business partnership. Hank attempts to mend fences between the estranged Marie and Skyler.

1396:2.title: Grilled
1396:2.overview: Walt and Jesse find themselves in close quarters with an unhinged Tuco. Marie and Hank comfort Skyler, who is distraught over Walt’s disappearance. Hank pays a visit to Mrs. Pinkman on some not-so-official business.

1396:2.title: Bit by a Dead Bee
1396:2.overview: Walt and Jesse become short on cash when they try to cover their tracks. Meanwhile, the DEA has a lead that could them straight to Walt and Jesse.

1396:2.title: Down
1396:2.overview: Walt attempts to reconnect with his family, while Jesse struggles to rebuild his life.

1396:2.title: Breakage
1396:2.overview: Hank suffers from the aftermath of his encounter with Tuco. Meanwhile, Jesse hires a crew to get their product out on the streets.

1396:2.title: Peekaboo
1396:2.overview: Walt's secret is in jeopardy when Skyler thanks Gretchen for paying for his treatment.

1396:2.title: Negro y Azul
1396:2.overview: Jesse and Walt discuss expanding into new territories; Hank struggles to fit in; Skyler pursues a new job opportunity; Jesse gets to know his landlord.

1396:2.title: Better Call Saul
1396:2.overview: Walt and Jesse seek advice from a shady attorney when Badger gets in trouble with the law; the DEA believes they have caught up with "Heisenberg" ; Hank returns.

1396:2.title: 4 Days Out
1396:2.overview: Walt and his family wait for news after he undergoes a PET-CT scan. Walt follows Saul's advice; Jesse's relationship with Jane is put on hold when he and Walt head to the desert for a marathon of cooking.

1396:2.title: Over
1396:2.overview: Walt and Hank get into a heated argument at a party. Skyler opens up to her boss. Jane hides her relationship with Jesse from her father.

1396:2.title: Mandala
1396:2.overview: As the end of her pregnancy finds Skyler conflicted about her feelings, a dealer's death forces Walt to look for somewhere to unload a load of meth.

1396:2.title: Phoenix
1396:2.overview: As Walt explores money laundering options, he and Jesse spar over the profits from their latest deal. Jesse and Jane clash with her father. Walt makes a fatal decision.

1396:2.title: ABQ
1396:2.overview: Skyler confronts Walt about his secrecy; Jesse falls apart; and Jane's grief-stricken father takes action that results in further tragedy.

100088:1.title: When You're Lost in the Darkness
100088:1.overview: 2003. As a parasitic fungal outbreak begins to ravage the country and the world, Joel Miller attempts to escape the escalating chaos with his daughter and brother. Twenty years later, a now hardened Joel and his partner Tess fight to survive under a totalitarian regime, while the insurgent Fireflies harbor a teenage girl with a unique gift.

100088:1.title: Infected
100088:1.overview: In 2003, an Indonesian scientist makes a devastating discovery. In 2023, now outside of the quarantine zone, Joel and Tess clash over Ellie's fate as they navigate a long-abandoned Boston overrun with Infected.

100088:1.title: Long, Long Time
100088:1.overview: Doomsday prepper Bill prepares to ride out the apocalypse alone...until a mysterious stranger upends his plans. Years later, Joel and Ellie seek Bill's guidance – and find themselves at a crossroads.

100088:1.title: Please Hold to My Hand
100088:1.overview: After a harrowing trek across a desolate United States, Joel and Ellie find themselves navigating a dangerous Kansas City on foot. Later, rebel leader Kathleen instigates a manhunt – one that pits her violent civilian militia against the world's best hope.

100088:1.title: Endure and Survive
100088:1.overview: On the streets of a newly free Kansas City, Henry fights to protect his brother Sam from rebel soldiers who will stop at nothing to appease their ruthless leader. As her manhunt continues, Kathleen doubles down on her quest for revenge, while Ellie forms a meaningful friendship.

100088:1.title: Kin
100088:1.overview: After months of traveling, Joel and Ellie receive a grave warning about what lies ahead. Later, Ellie learns more about Joel's past – while Joel tries his best to forget.

100088:1.title: Left Behind
100088:1.overview: As Joel fights to survive, Ellie’s struggle to save him stirs memories of her life in a FEDRA orphanage. Weeks before meeting Joel, Ellie recalls joining her best friend Riley for a night to remember… one that will change the course of both of their lives – and the fate of the world – forever.

100088:1.title: When We Are in Need
100088:1.overview: After crossing paths with a vengeful group of survivors, Ellie's fighting spirit draws unwanted attention from its leader. Still battling for his life, a weakened Joel faces off with a hunting party out for blood.

100088:1.title: Look for the Light
100088:1.overview: After being pursued by Infected, a pregnant Anna places her trust in a lifelong friend. Years later, Ellie is forced to grapple with the emotional toll of her journey, while Joel faces a devastating decision of his own.

100088:2.title: Future Days
100088:2.overview: Five years after the events in Salt Lake City, a now 19-year-old Ellie makes a discovery while on patrol with her best friend Dina. Back in Jackson Hole, Joel seeks help to mend his relationship with Ellie.

100088:2.title: Through the Valley
100088:2.overview: As a storm brews in the mountains, the people of Jackson Hole prepare for the worst amid increased sightings of Infected. Meanwhile, Abby weighs her options.

100088:2.title: The Path
100088:2.overview: After Dina shares crucial information, Ellie prepares to petition the town council, even while she struggles with her deep emotional scars. On the outskirts of Seattle, a religious sect attempts to flee a war – raising questions on what lies ahead.

100088:2.title: Day One
100088:2.overview: In 2018, Seattle FEDRA confronts an unexpected foe. Ten years later, Ellie and Dina find themselves in the middle of a bloody battle between the zealous Seraphites and a ruthless militia.

100088:2.title: Feel Her Love
100088:2.overview: The WLF makes a dangerous discovery... at a great cost. Later, Ellie must decide whether to continue with her plan – and risk putting Dina in danger – or give up on her quest for justice.

100088:2.title: The Price
100088:2.overview: Joel surprises Ellie for her birthday. Years later, Ellie prepares to confront Joel about her past.

100088:2.title: Convergence
100088:2.overview: As the Wolves and the Scars prepare for a battle that could potentially end their longstanding feud, Ellie's search draws her away from her friends and toward a devastating confrontation.

82856:1.title: Chapter 1: The Mandalorian
82856:1.overview: A Mandalorian bounty hunter tracks a target for a well-paying client.

82856:1.title: Chapter 2: The Child
82856:1.overview: Target in-hand, the Mandalorian must now contend with scavengers.

82856:1.title: Chapter 3: The Sin
82856:1.overview: The battered Mandalorian returns to his client for reward.

82856:1.title: Chapter 4: Sanctuary
82856:1.overview: The Mandalorian teams up with an ex-soldier to protect a village from raiders.

82856:1.title: Chapter 5: The Gunslinger
82856:1.overview: The Mandalorian helps a rookie bounty hunter who is in over his head.

82856:1.title: Chapter 6: The Prisoner
82856:1.overview: The Mandalorian joins a crew of mercenaries on a dangerous mission.

82856:1.title: Chapter 7: The Reckoning
82856:1.overview: An old rival extends an invitation for The Mandalorian to make peace.

82856:1.title: Chapter 8: Redemption
82856:1.overview: The Mandalorian comes face-to-face with an unexpected enemy.

82856:2.title: Chapter 9: The Marshal
82856:2.overview: The Mandalorian is drawn to the Outer Rim in search of others of his kind.

82856:2.title: Chapter 10: The Passenger
82856:2.overview: The Mandalorian must ferry a passenger with precious cargo on a risky journey.

82856:2.title: Chapter 11: The Heiress
82856:2.overview: The Mandalorian braves high seas and meets unexpected allies.

82856:2.title: Chapter 12: The Siege
82856:2.overview: The Mandalorian rejoins old allies for a new mission.

82856:2.title: Chapter 13: The Jedi
82856:2.overview: The Mandalorian journeys to a world ruled by a cruel magistrate who has made a powerful enemy.

82856:2.title: Chapter 14: The Tragedy
82856:2.overview: The Mandalorian and Child travel to an ancient site.

82856:2.title: Chapter 15: The Believer
82856:2.overview: To move against the Empire, the Mandalorian needs the help of an old enemy.

82856:2.title: Chapter 16: The Rescue
82856:2.overview: The Mandalorian and his allies attempt a daring rescue.
